steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Button gap check
steps.body: Gap required between control panel buttons and tact switches — stuck button triggers BC2 after ~30 s. Loosen over-tightened sub PBA screws.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Gap required between control panel buttons and tact switches — stuck button triggers BC2 after ~30 s. Loosen over-tightened sub PBA screws.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Loosen service screws; replace main PBA if IC fault.

steps.title: Adjust panel
steps.oemOutcome: Loosen service screws and verify button free play.

steps.title: HMI OK
steps.oemOutcome: Control panel and tact switches verified.
